chunks.content: Owned AWS account structure (Organizations + SCPs) and wrote all infra as Terraform modules with a shared registry.
Built GitHub Actions pipelines for build/test/deploy with matrix strategies for Java and Node.
Ran a small on-prem OpenStack lab for cost benchmarking experiments.
Attended a Rust language user group monthly for two years.
Wrote CloudFormation templates before the team migrated to Terraform.

query: AWS infrastructure engineer who writes Terraform modules and manages cloud account structures.
notes: Chunks 0 and 1 directly match AWS+Terraform and GitHub Actions. Chunk 4 mentions Terraform but only historically (post-migration) — adjacent, not the ask. Chunk 2 (OpenStack) and chunk 3 (Rust) are distractors. Keyword arm should nail 0; naive vector may pull 4 up on 'Terraform' proximity. QUERY REDESIGN (v1.2.M2): 'AWS Terraform modules' targets chunk 0 — plainto_tsquery 'aws' & 'terraform' & 'modul' all appear in chunk 0. Chunk 4 has 'terraform' but not 'aws' or 'modules', so the AND-conjunction filters it. Chunk 1 (GitHub Actions) has none of the three tokens and must be found by the vector arm. Keyword-arm expected hit: chunk 0 only.
